solution_summary: Panalgo , a Norstella company, ran its analytics solution Instant Health Data (IHD) on premises for 8 years prior to migrating to Amazon Web Services (AWS) in 2022. Soon after, Panalgo’s customers expressed a need for more control over their data. In response, Panalgo started developing a solution in 2023 that helps customers deploy and manage IHD analytics within their own cloud environments. Managing Sensitive Health Data with Care IHD is Panalgo’s flagship healthcare analytics solution that has changed the way pharma and life sciences teams conduct data analysis—replacing complex programming and yielding results in minutes. Organizations in the life sciences frequently handle sensitive health data and must comply with stringent regulatory requirements related to data sovereignty and security, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, General Data Protection Regulation, and HITRUST .
